cite: Perfect Corp YouCam API POST /s2s/v2.0/task/face-attr-analysis, results.facialratio (OpenAPI document perfect-corp-ai_face_analyzer.json, mirrored at github.com/api-evangelist/perfect-corp openapi/_original/); Make Over's face analysis is Perfect Corp's (Perfect Corp x Make Over, ParagonCorp Beauty Science & Technology 2026). Every [1, x] direction below is an ASSUMPTION (first quantity = 1) until checked against one real Make Over screen.

comparisons.name: thirds
comparisons.note: Percent of face height, upper/middle/lower. Our upper third starts at the mesh top (landmark 10), a proxy: the mesh has no hairline. Our middle third is glabella to subnasale, lower is subnasale to menton. The vendor's points are not documented.

comparisons.name: fifths
comparisons.note: Percent of face width, subject's right to left. Our outer fifths end at the face-oval extremes (234/454), a proxy, not zygion. The vendor's points are not documented.

comparisons.name: faceAspect
comparisons.note: Vendor: width of the face to its height, [1, x], ASSUMED x = height / width. Ours: width_length_ratio (oval-extreme width over mesh-top-to-menton length, both proxies), inverted.

comparisons.name: eyeAspect
comparisons.note: Vendor: height of the eye to its width, [1, x], ASSUMED x = width / height; left and right averaged. Ours: eye_aperture_ratio (lid 159/145 over corner-to-corner width, mean of both eyes), inverted.

comparisons.name: browArch
comparisons.note: Vendor: brow forepart (start to arch) to total brow width, [1, x], ASSUMED x = total / forepart; left and right averaged. Ours: brow_peak_position (0 medial to 1 lateral along the brow chord, = forepart / total), inverted.

comparisons.name: eyeHeightToBrow
comparisons.note: Vendor: eye height to the vertical distance from the top of the eyebrow to the bottom of the eye, [1, x], ASSUMED x = distance / eye height; left and right averaged. Ours: eye_height_to_brow_distance (vertical lid height over highest upper-brow point to lower lid, mean of both eyes), inverted.

comparisons.name: noseAspect
comparisons.note: Vendor: width of the nose to its height, [1, x], ASSUMED x = height / width. Ours: nose_aspect_ratio (nostril-base width 98/327, a proxy for alare, over nasion 168 to subnasale), inverted.

comparisons.name: noseToMouth
comparisons.note: Vendor: nose width to mouth width, [1, x], ASSUMED x = mouth / nose. Ours: alar_width_to_mouth_ratio (nostril-base proxy over cheilion to cheilion), inverted.

comparisons.name: noseLipChin
comparisons.note: Vendor: nose tip to mid-lips, to mid-lips to chin, [1, x], ASSUMED x = (lips to chin) / (nose tip to lips). Ours: lower_face_split, which starts at SUBNASALE, not the nose tip, so ours is systematically shifted; inverted.

comparisons.name: lips
comparisons.note: Vendor: upper lip height to lower lip height, [1, x], ASSUMED x = lower / upper. Ours: upper_lower_lip_ratio (upper over lower vermilion height), inverted.

unused.overall_eye_height_to_eyebrow_distance: Left and right are compared, averaged; whether overall is their mean is not documented.
